deadlines.label: Closing Date for Applications
deadlines.quote: Closing Date for Applications: 10/31/2026 Closing Date Explanation Electronically submitted applications must be submitted no later than 11:59 PM, ET, on the listed application due date.

caps.what: Federal funding request as a percent of total project cost
caps.quote: The total Federal funding request cannot exceed 50% of the total project cost.

caps.what: percent of a grant award a State may use to administer the HCA program
caps.quote: A State may use up to five percent of a grant award to administer the HCA program.

match.quote: Cost Sharing Required? Yes 50 percent non-Federal cost share required.

award.quote: Each State may request up to $2,293,362 in Base funding. The earliest anticipated project start date is January 1, 2026. Project periods will be no longer than 4 years from the date the grantee is notified of an award.

sections.name: Project Abstract Summary
sections.quote: Project Abstract Summary (OMB 4040-0019). Must include, in plain language: Award purpose, Activities to be performed,

sections.name: Need
sections.quote: Need: Describe why the proposed land acquisition is needed. Describe how the proposed land acquisition fulfills the purposes of the Highlands Conservation Act and meets the Department of the Interior priorities

sections.name: Purpose
sections.quote: Purpose: Explain what is to be accomplished during the period of the project pursuant to the stated need.

sections.name: Objective
sections.quote: Objective: Specify the type of interest and acres to be acquired. Specify the target acquisition date.

sections.name: Expected Results or Benefits
sections.quote: Expected Results or Benefits: Each parcel must show that at least one of the following resources (identified in the HCA program authorizing legislation) is of "high conservation value"

sections.name: Approach
sections.quote: Approach: Explain how the objective(s) will be attained. Include specific procedures, schedules, key cooperators, and respective roles. Describe any subaward relationships.

sections.name: Location
sections.quote: Location: Describe and show the parcel(s) proposed for acquisition. Proposals must include at minimum an aerial map of the proposed properties

sections.name: Stakeholder Coordination/Involvement
sections.quote: Stakeholder Coordination/Involvement As applicable, describe how your organization has coordinated with and involved other relevant organizations or individuals in planning the project

sections.name: Description of Entities Undertaking the Project
sections.quote: Description of Entities Undertaking the Project: Provide a brief description of the applicant organization and all participating entities and individuals.

criteria.name: 1. Project is in the Highlands Region or an approved Highlands Expansion Opportunity Area municipality (minimum criterion)
criteria.quote: Minimum Criteria for all projects: 1. Project is either 1) in the Highlands Region as defined in the NY-NJ Highlands Regional Study: 2002 Update

criteria.name: 3. High conservation value
criteria.quote: a) Project Narrative clearly demonstrates the project has high conservation value. 25-50 points. b) Project Narrative does not demonstrate that the project has high conservation value. 0-24 points.

criteria.name: c) Presidential and Department of Interior Priorities
criteria.quote: c) Presidential and Department of Interior Priorities Up to 20 points may be awarded based on the extent that the project demonstrably:

other: Do not encrypt, zip, or password-protect any files
format.quote: Do not encrypt, zip, or password-protect any files.

eligibility.item: Only the Lead State Agency (or Agencies) designated by the Governor of Connecticut, New Jersey, New York, or Pennsylvania may apply (State governments)
eligibility.quote: Only the Lead State Agency (or Agencies) as determined by the Governor of each Highlands State may be the applicant for funding under the Highlands Conservation Act Grant Program.

eligibility.item: If the Governor assigns multiple Lead Agencies, they must coordinate requests before submission and not exceed the maximum allowable amount
eligibility.quote: If the Governor assigns multiple Lead Agencies, those Agencies must coordinate on funding requests prior to submission and ensure no more than the maximum allowable amount is requested through this funding opportunity.

eligibility.item: Each parcel must be in the Highlands Region or in a Highlands Expansion Opportunity Area municipality approved by the Service
eligibility.quote: To be eligible for Highlands Conservation Act Grant funding, a parcel must be either 1) in the Highlands Region as defined in the NY-NJ Highlands Regional Study: 2002 Update

eligibility.item: Only land acquisition projects (fee or conservation easement from a willing seller) and associated administrative costs are funded
eligibility.quote: The HCA Grant Program funds only land acquisition projects and associated administrative costs.

eligibility.item: Acquired land may be held only by a State Conservation Agency, County, or Municipality; a State Agency may co-hold a conservation easement with a County, Municipality, or non-profit land conservation organization
eligibility.quote: A State Conservation Agency, or a County or Municipality through a subaward agreement, may hold the interest in the land acquired. For conservation easements (CE), a State Agency may co-hold the CE with a County, Municipality, or a non-profit land conservation organization.

eligibility.item: A project may not be proposed in both the Base and the Competitive funding opportunities
eligibility.quote: A project may not be proposed for funding in both funding opportunities.

eligibility.item: Register in SAM.gov (obtaining a UEI) and certify the Financial Assistance General Representations and Certifications before applying
eligibility.quote: Before applying, all applicants except individuals applying as a natural person must be registered in SAM.gov. During the SAM.gov registration the entity will obtain their Unique Entity Identifier (UEI).

eligibility.item: Register the organization with GrantSolutions and assign at least the Authorizing Official and PI/PD user roles
eligibility.quote: This program accepts applications through GrantSolutions.gov. You must register with GrantSolutions. See Submission Instructions.

eligibility.item: By applying, the applicant certifies awareness of and compliance with all applicable executive orders and Secretary's orders
eligibility.quote: By applying in response to this Notice of Funding Opportunity, the applicant certifies awareness and compliance with all currently effective and applicable executive orders and secretary's orders

eligibility.item: Projects must meet Criteria 1 and 2 and score 35 points or higher on Criteria 3 to be eligible for funding
eligibility.quote: Projects that meet Criteria 1 and 2 and score 35 points or higher in Criteria 3 as determined by the Merit Review Panel will be eligible for funding.

requiredDocuments.item: SF-424, Application for Federal Assistance (all applicants)
SF-424A, Budget Information - Non-Construction Programs (non-construction projects)
SF-424C, Budget Information - Construction Programs (construction projects)
SF-429 Cover Page and Attachment B, Request to Acquire, Improve, or Furnish Real Property, if acquiring real property (may instead be submitted after award notification)
requiredDocuments.quote: SF-429 (Cover Page & Attachment B), Request to Acquire,

requiredDocuments.item: SF-LLL, Disclosure of Lobbying Activities, if requesting more than $100,000 and non-Federal funds are used for lobbying
Aerial map of the proposed properties and a map showing their location relative to the Highlands Region boundary
requiredDocuments.quote: Proposals must include at minimum an aerial map of the proposed properties and a map showing the location of proposed properties in relation to the Highlands Region boundary.

requiredDocuments.item: Budget Narrative justifying costs (total estimated costs, non-Federal cost share, third-party contributions, pre-award costs, indirect cost method, per-property cost breakdown)
requiredDocuments.quote: Applicants must describe and justify items and costs listed in their budget. The budget narrative must identify the following cost items: total estimated costs, non-Federal cost share, third-party contributions, and any pre-award costs.

requiredDocuments.item: Copy of the most recently negotiated indirect cost rate agreement, if the organization has previously negotiated a rate
requiredDocuments.quote: If your organization has previously negotiated a rate, attach a copy of the most recently negotiated rate agreement (active or expired).

requiredDocuments.item: Conflict of interest disclosure, if any actual or potential conflict of interest exists
requiredDocuments.quote: If any actual or potential conflict of interest exists related to this project at the time of application, the applicant must provide sufficient information to support a program determination of significance

requiredDocuments.item: Overlap or Duplication of Effort Statement (a statement of no overlap, or details of overlapping activities, costs, and key personnel time)
requiredDocuments.quote: Applicants must state in their application if the activities, costs, or time commitment of key personnel proposed in this application overlap with those in any other Federal proposal or award or not.

requiredDocuments.item: Copy of any overlapping or duplicative proposal submitted to another funding entity, with when, to whom, and expected decision date
requiredDocuments.quote: A copy of any overlapping or duplicative proposal submitted to any other potential funding entity.
